title: Preserve newer-origin wait replacement hints when merging an older retry
outcome: Review7 Claude Note: requestStateResync merges a scheduled wait retry into pending options before the fresh request. An older-origin retry rearmed by an in-flight failure can overwrite pending newer-origin replacement evidence; a fresh hintless request then loses the newer hint. Normal SSE reconnect still recovers. First reproduce with origin change during an in-flight wait repair and assert preservation of the current-origin hint. Keep retired-origin adoption guards. This is separate from the main wait-ordering fix and is not a confirmed blocking defect.
